components.name: Uniform dyadic split-repair mass
components.project_addition: Use exact P017 cofactor-root branch arithmetic to localize failed p-rough realizability to endpoint intervals of the sqrt(p) Beatty rotation; combine a uniform Jacobsthal p-rough gap bound with quadratic-irrational discrepancy to prove sum_{K<k<=2K} S(k) >> K^(7/6)/log K, and derive the general rough-gap exponent transfer law.
